function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "python - <<'EOF'
from measure import Impl as M
from slugify import Impl as S
from ranges import Impl as R
m, s, r = M(), S(), R()
assert m.to_cm(1.5, "m") == 150
assert m.to_cm(3, "cm") == 3
assert m.to_cm(20, "mm") == 2
assert m.to_cm(0, "m") == 0
assert m.to_cm(2.34, "m") == 234
try:
    m.to_cm(1, "ft"); raise SystemExit("fail: bad unit accepted")
except ValueError as e:
    print("ValueError ok:", e)
assert s.slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
assert s.slugify("  --A@@B-- ") == "a-b"
assert s.slugify("***") == "untitled"
assert s.slugify("") == "untitled"
assert s.slugify("Already-Slug_9") == "already-slug-9"
assert r.merge([[5,7],[1,3],[2,4]]) == [(1,4),(5,7)]
assert r.merge([]) == []
assert r.merge([[1,1]]) == [(1,1)]
assert r.merge([[1,3],[3,5]]) == [(1,5)]
assert r.merge([(3,5),(1,2)]) == [(1,5)]
assert r.merge([[1,10],[2,3],[4,5]]) == [(1,10)]
print("all edge checks passed")
EOF"}
